# ClaudeMC v1.18.0

## What's new

### AI-powered targeted server search
ServerFinder gains a new **AI Search** mode. Set the `Query` field to anything — `"EssentialsX dupe"`, `"Log4Shell"`, `"forceop vulnerable"` — and the mod asks the AI to determine which server software is relevant, queries mcscans.fi accordingly, and filters results by keyword. Falls back to VulnDb string matching if no AI key is configured.

### In-game editing for all settings
**Every module setting is now editable from the ClickGUI** — no file editing ever needed. Free-text settings (e.g. ServerFinder `Query`, AutoAuth password, SmartReply custom text) now show an inline text editor when left-clicked in the expanded settings panel:
- Type freely; a yellow `|` cursor marks the active field
- **Enter** or clicking away saves; **Esc** cancels
- **Right-click** a text field to clear it

### DupeDB integration
ClaudeMC now connects to **[dupedb.net](https://dupedb.net)** on every launch (once per 23 hours, cached):
- **Public feed** (no auth) — injects the 10 most recent community-verified exploits into VulnDb automatically
- **AI + web search** — 3 DuckDuckGo queries scoped to Minecraft 1.21.x feed into the AI, which structures confirmed server-side exploits into VulnDb entries (requires API key)
- **Authenticated search** — ServerFinder and ExploitAdvisor can query the full DupeDB search API filtered by version/plugin (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, one-time browser consent)

### ServerFinder fixes and new options
- Fixed the MCScans API parser — now uses Gson against the real field schema (`hostname`, `playerStats.onlinePlayers`, `authMode`); previous regex parser was silently returning zero results
- New **OfflineOnly** setting restricts results to cracked/offline-mode servers
- All four ServerFinder settings are configurable in-game

## Fixes
- SmartReply fallback response changed from `"AFK, brb"` to `"yeah im here, what's up"` — a giveaway AFK response defeats the purpose of the module
- README AutoMine staff-detection section corrected — the module locks camera completely during a staff break and never looks around underground; the vein look-around is a separate behaviour
- Removed stale `(v1.3)` version tags from ForceOP, ForceCreative, and VanishDetect README headings
